sources.name: Perplexity Help Center: Canceling a subscription

caption:
Canceling Perplexity happens where you paid: on the web in Settings, on a phone through Apple, Google or Samsung.
Deleting your account does not stop the billing, so cancel first.
The refund window for a monthly plan is only 24 hours in most countries. Here is how it all works.

How many AI subscriptions are you paying for right now?

Follow @neurafeed.ai for daily AI news.

Source: Perplexity Help Center · Photo: Perplexity
threads_text: Canceling Perplexity is easy on the web, but if you paid through the App Store or Google Play you have to cancel there. And deleting your account does not stop the charges. How many AI subscriptions are you paying for right now?

slides.headline: How to cancel *Perplexity*, and the 24 hour refund window

slides.heading: 1. On the web: *Manage Subscription*
paras: Open Settings, find Subscription, click Manage Subscription and choose Cancel subscription.
You keep Pro until the end of the billing cycle you already paid for.

slides.heading: 2. On a phone: *where you paid*
paras: Bought in the app? Cancel in the App Store, Google Play or Galaxy Store subscriptions.

paras.t: Deleting your account does not end the subscription.

slides.heading: 3. Refunds: *move fast*
paras: Outside the EU, UK, Turkey, South Korea and Brazil, monthly plans get 24 hours and annual plans 72 hours.
Send one request only. Duplicate tickets go to the back of the queue.

site_article.headline: Perplexity: how to cancel your subscription on the web, iPhone and Android
site_article.dek: Where you cancel depends on where you paid. Here are the steps for each platform, what happens to your account, and the short refund windows.
site_article.summary: To cancel Perplexity Pro or Max bought on the web, open Settings, then Subscription, click Manage Subscription and choose Cancel subscription. Plans bought in the app are canceled in the App Store, Google Play or Galaxy Store, and your account returns to the free version when the billing cycle ends.
site_article.seo_title: How to cancel a Perplexity subscription (web, iPhone, Android)
site_article.seo_description: Step by step: cancel Perplexity Pro or Max on the web, iPhone, Android and Galaxy Store, what happens after, and the 24 and 72 hour refund rules.
site_article.answer_summary: On the web, open Settings, find Subscription, click Manage Subscription and choose Cancel subscription. If you subscribed in the iPhone or Android app, cancel in the App Store or Google Play instead. Deleting your account does not cancel billing.
site_article.hero_alt: Promotional image from Perplexity showing its AI search app.

paragraphs.text: How to cancel a Perplexity subscription comes down to one rule from Perplexity's own help center: cancel on the platform where you bought it. If you paid on perplexity.ai, you cancel in Perplexity's settings. If you paid inside the iPhone or Android app, Apple, Google or Samsung handles the billing, and Perplexity's settings will not even show a cancel option for that subscription.

After you cancel, the help center says your account goes back to the free version when the current billing cycle ends, so you keep your paid features until then. If you do nothing, the plan keeps renewing on your original billing date. The same steps apply to Pro and Max, according to Krater's walkthrough, which it says it checked on October 1, 2026.
How to cancel a Perplexity subscription on the web

paragraphs.title: 1. Log in on perplexity.ai
paragraphs.text: Use the account that holds the subscription. The same account settings are used on the desktop.

paragraphs.title: 2. Open Settings, then Subscription
paragraphs.text: Find the Subscription section and click Manage Subscription. Krater notes this opens the Stripe billing portal that Perplexity uses for web payments.

paragraphs.title: 3. Choose Cancel subscription
paragraphs.text: Confirm the cancellation. Then go back to Manage Subscription and check that the plan now shows as canceled.
Do not delete your account to stop paying. Perplexity's help center says deleting the account does not end the subscription. Cancel first, then delete the account if you still want to.
How to cancel Perplexity on iPhone

paragraphs.title: 1. Open the App Store
paragraphs.text: Tap your profile icon, then Subscriptions. You can also get there from the iPhone Settings app by tapping your name, then Subscriptions.

paragraphs.title: 2. Cancel Perplexity
paragraphs.text: Select Perplexity - Ask Anything and tap Cancel subscription.
How to cancel Perplexity on Android

paragraphs.title: Google Play
paragraphs.text: Open Google Play, go to Payments and subscriptions, select Perplexity - Ask Anything, and tap Cancel subscription at the bottom of the page.

paragraphs.title: Samsung Galaxy Store
paragraphs.text: Sign in with the Samsung account you used to buy the plan, open the Menu, tap Subscriptions, select Perplexity and choose Unsubscribe. The help center adds that the Perplexity Android app's Settings also has a Manage Subscriptions option.

If you are still charged after canceling, Perplexity says to confirm the cancellation under Manage subscription in Settings, and to contact support through Help, then Contact Support, if the charges continue.
Perplexity refunds: the windows are short

Refunds depend on where you live and which plan you pay for. Perplexity's refund article gives customers in the EU, the UK and Turkey 14 days from purchase to cancel, and customers in South Korea and Brazil 7 days, for both monthly and annual plans. They should say in the request which of those places they are applying from.

Everyone else has much less time. A monthly plan can be refunded only if you ask within 24 hours of the purchase and give a reason. An annual plan gets a full refund if you ask within 72 hours of the original purchase, and Perplexity says it makes no exceptions after that. Once one refund has been granted on an account, further requests are not processed.

paragraphs.title: Refund on the web
paragraphs.text: Go to perplexity.ai/pro, select Manage Subscription, then Cancel Plan. The refund option appears with the cancellation confirmation. If it does not, contact support through Help, then Contact Support.

paragraphs.title: Refund for an iPhone purchase
paragraphs.text: Apple took the payment, so the request goes to Apple. Sign in at reportaproblem.apple.com with the Apple ID you used, find the purchase and tap Request a refund.

paragraphs.title: Refund for a Google Play or Galaxy Store purchase
paragraphs.text: For Google Play, contact Perplexity support and include your Google Play email address. In the Galaxy Store, open Menu, My page, Purchase history, find the subscription and tap Refund or Report problem; the help center says this is usually available within about 48 hours of purchase.

Two details can shrink a refund. Perplexity says each Computer credit you used lowers the refund by one cent, and heavy use of the monthly credits can make a Max payment ineligible. Accounts closed for breaking the Terms of Use get no refund at all.

Send one refund request and wait. The help center says duplicate tickets can push you to the back of the queue, and that it judges eligibility by the date you sent the request, not the date support answers.

The practical lesson: if you are only testing Perplexity, set a reminder for the day after you subscribe, because outside Europe, Turkey, South Korea and Brazil the monthly refund window closes after 24 hours. And always cancel in the same store you paid in. The common trap is deleting the app or the account while the App Store or Google Play subscription keeps running.
